legacyReceiptReconciliation.method: For each legacy JPEG, the completed built-in ImageGen receipt ID, exact revised-prompt SHA-256, original PNG SHA-256, and active source JPEG SHA-256 were recovered. Re-encoding the recorded PNG with the recorded macOS sips settings reproduced the active JPEG byte-for-byte. Prompts and image bytes were not rewritten.

sharedPrompt: Create one original 3:2 antiquarian natural-history folio with exactly six independent framed compartments in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid, read A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, B3. Use iron-gall ink, fine cross-hatching and stipple, restrained hand-tinted mineral pigments on warm aged vellum: ancient, timeless, beautiful, rough and polished at once. Keep one complete centered subject cluster per compartment, ample breathing room, thin irregular ink rules, and no object crossing a gutter. Palette: parchment, umber, lampblack, muted verdigris, faded lapis, madder red, ochre. Every cell must be visibly different. No lettering, captions, labels, numerals, pseudo-writing, signatures, logos, watermarks, modern objects, photography, or glossy digital rendering.
